text: {"action":"NO_TRADE","sizePct":0,"stopPct":0,"conviction":0.5,"rationale":"The technical picture is genuinely bearish but only modestly so: close is just 1.6% below SMA20, with 20d momentum of -1.9% and 5d of -1.0%.
